title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 141 ]

blocks.text: Every parent know how crucial the choice of friends is for every child. Childhood friendships tell parents which ways their children are tending. They are important because good friendships bring you up, and bad friendships bring you down. So it matters who our children's friends are. And it matters, as example to our children, who our friends are. Friends should be allies of our better nature.

readingSentences.english: Every parent know how crucial the choice of friends is for every child.
readingSentences.korean: 부모들은 친구 선택이 모든 아이들에게 얼마나 중요한지를 안다.

readingSentences.english: Childhood friendships tell parents which ways their children are tending.
readingSentences.korean: 소시적 친구관계 로부터 부모들은 아이들이 어떤 경향으로 흐르고 있는지를 알 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: They are important because good friendships bring you up, and bad friendships bring you down.
readingSentences.korean: 훌륭한 우 정은 여러분을 성장하게 하고 잘못된 우정은 여러분을 저하시키기 때문에 우정은 중요하다.

readingSentences.english: So it matters who our children's friends are.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 누가 우리 애들의 친구인가는 중요하다.

readingSentences.english: And it matters, as example to our children, who our friends are.
readingSentences.korean: 애들에 대한 본보기로, 우리의 친구가 누구냐 하는 것도 중요하다.

readingSentences.english: Friends should be allies of our better nature.
readingSentences.korean: 친구란 보다 나은 부리의 본성의 연합 체 여야 한다.
